// NEGATIVE fixture — `await` only inside a function body, and in inert positions.
// A line comment: await load()
/* A block comment: await load() */
const SINGLE = 'await load()';
const DOUBLE = "await load()";
const TEMPLATE = `top-level await is banned: await load()`;
const IN_REGEX = /(^|[^.\w])await\s/;

export function mentionsAwait(source) {
  return /(^|[^.\w])await\s/.test(source);
}

export async function boot(load) {
  const config = await load();
  return config;
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
